note: Styles mixed within one document, links pasted raw, and two forms inlineCitation.ts documents as knowingly undetected. Those are labelled as citations anyway: a writer who typed one has cited their sentence whatever the detector can see, and a recall figure that quietly excluded them would be measuring the detector's opinion of itself.
